name: Oswin Fernhollow
greetings: Ho there! Smell that? Fresh-cut spruce. Best smell there is.
Found a Heartwood Splinter? Bring me a few and we'll talk stumps.
Ironbark won't budge for a stone axe. You'll want iron, at least.
Duskwillow only grows by water, and only at night. Shy trees, those.
Plant two for every one you fell, and the woods will love you back.
